summary: Frontend-only UI/UX testing of Vértice Sports admin area (mobile drawer, quick actions, responsive cards/table, RBAC guard). Executed 25 scenarios across 390px mobile, 1440px desktop viewports using Playwright with page.route() mocks for /api/auth/me, /api/admin/stats, /api/bets/admin/all, /api/admin/users, PATCH/DELETE. All 25 scenarios PASS. yarn build compiles cleanly with no ESLint warnings (useCallback fix in Usuarios.jsx is correct).

issues: Radix a11y console warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. The SheetContent (based on Radix Dialog) should include a visually hidden <SheetTitle> and <SheetDescription> (or aria-describedby={undefined}) for screen reader users. Cosmetic/a11y only – does not block functionality.

action_items: (Optional/A11y) Add VisuallyHidden SheetTitle + SheetDescription inside the mobile <SheetContent data-testid='admin-mobile-drawer'> in /app/frontend/src/components/layout/AdminLayout.jsx to silence Radix Dialog a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Bilhetes.jsx line 60-74: useEffect for search params has 'eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps'. Acceptable here (one-shot on mount), but consider extracting the ?new=1 handling into a useCallback-based effect to align with the pattern established in Usuarios.jsx.
AdminLayout.jsx correctly closes the drawer on route change via useEffect([location.pathname]) — verified functional.
Usuarios.jsx load = useCallback with stable [] deps and useEffect([load]) is the correct fix for the eslint warning. Confirmed no build warnings.
AdminLayout RBAC guard (lines 68-72) correctly redirects both unauthenticated and non-admin users to /login?redirect=/admin. Verified with mocked USER role.
Role select correctly restricts to only 'USER' option for non-SUPER_ADMIN (disabled when role != USER).
test_credentials: No real credentials used — mocked /api/auth/me with SUPER_ADMIN user and injected fake vs_token via localStorage init script.
seed_data_creation: None (all data mocked via Playwright page.route()).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend (Cloudflare Worker + D1) is intentionally not running in preview env. Any admin UI test must mock /api/auth/me, /api/admin/stats, /api/bets/admin/all, /api/admin/users via page.route() and set localStorage 'vs_token' before navigating. Key data-testids verified working: admin-mobile-menu-btn, admin-mobile-drawer, admin-mobile-logout-btn, mobile-admin-nav-{overview|bilhetes|usuarios|inteligencia|planos|telegram|configuracoes}, quick-actions-section, qa-new-bet/manage-bets/manage-users, admin-bets-mobile-list, admin-bet-card-{id}, bet-action-{green|red|void|toggle-pub|delete}-{id}, users-mobile-list, user-card-{id}, user-plan-{id}, user-role-{id}, user-active-{id}, users-search-input, admin-sidebar. Note: bet-action-* testids exist on BOTH the mobile card AND desktop row; when using Playwright strict selectors on mobile, scope with locator('[data-testid=admin-bet-card-{id}]').locator(...). The desktop table remains in the DOM (hidden md:block) which is expected Tailwind responsive behavior. Logout button in mobile drawer may report x-offscreen coordinate mid-animation; use dispatch_event('click') or wait longer for the slide-in animation.
